title: document_extract run contract
description: run.json, written once at the output root when an extraction finishes. States what was extracted, from what, with which evidence-affecting settings, and where each artifact role lives relative to the root. Enforced by document_extract.contracts.validate_run.

contract_version.description: An unknown version is rejected with an instruction to re-extract. There is no compatibility reader.

filename.description: Base name only; never a server path.

page_count.description: Pages in the source PDF, not in the selection.

selection.description: The pages this run extracted. A partial run is normal and is stated here rather than inferred from the manifest length.

coordinate_convention.description: Every bbox in every artifact is [left, top, right, bottom] normalized to 0-1 with a top-left origin.

root.description: Role -> path relative to the output root.

page.description: Role -> path relative to a page directory.

evidence_bearing_roles.description: The roles a consumer must hash into a build fingerprint. Changing this list changes what triggers a rebuild.

settings.description: Extraction settings that can change what evidence exists or where it sits. Timeouts, concurrency, and URLs are deliberately excluded.

failed.description: A run with a failed page is not indexable.

total.description: Warning categories that actually fired, summed over pages. A category that is present but false is not a warning.

categories.description: Category name -> number of pages on which it fired.

stale_page_dirs.description: Page directories under the root this run did not produce. Never deleted; the consumer ignores them.
